name: AI Video Generator
description:
OVERVIEW
Transform any trending headline or broad topic into a polished, vertical short-form video in a single run.  
The agent automates research, scriptwriting, metadata creation, and Revid.ai rendering, returning one ready-to-publish MP4 plus its title, script and hashtags.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Input a topic or an exact news headline.  
2. The agent fetches live search results and selects the most engaging related story.  
3. Key facts are summarised into concise research notes.  
4. Claude writes a 30–35 second script with visual cues, a three-second hook, tension loops, and a call-to-action.  
5. GPT-4o generates an eye-catching title and one or two discoverability hashtags.  
6. The script is sent to a state-of-the-art AI video generator to render a single 9:16 MP4 (default: 720 p, 30 fps, voice “Brian”, style “movingImage”, music “Bladerunner 2049”).  
   – All voice, style and resolution settings can be adjusted in the Builder before you press "Run".  
7. Output delivered: Title, Script, Hashtags, Video URL.

KEY USE CASES
- Broad-topic explainers (e.g. “Artificial Intelligence” or “Climate Tech”).  
- Real-time newsjacking with a specific breaking headline.  
- Product-launch spotlights and quick event recaps while interest is high.  

BUSINESS VALUE
- One-click speed: from idea to finished video in minutes.  
- Consistent brand look: Revid presets keep voice, style and aspect ratio on spec.  
- No-code workflow: marketers create social video without design or development queues.  
- Cloud convenience: Auto-GPT Cloud users are pre-configured with all required keys.  
  Self-hosted users simply add OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity (OpenRouter/Jina) and Revid keys once.

IMPORTANT NOTES
- The agent outputs exactly one video per execution. Run it again for additional shorts.  
- Video rendering time varies; AI-generated footage may take several minutes.

name: Product Launch Tracker & Reporter
description:
New products appear every day—often before the market even notices. This AI-powered agent makes sure **you** are the first to know.

### What it does for you

* **Scans the web every morning** across tech sites, startup databases and industry publications, looking only for items that launched within your chosen time window.
* **Verifies every date** against multiple sources, so rumours and “coming-soon” posts never clutter your feed.
* **Packages the intel in a clean email** with product name, company, launch date and a one-line summary—ready to forward to teammates or drop into your roadmap.

### Three-step setup

1. **Pick your focus.** Enter a topic such as “AI dev tools” or “sustainable beauty.”
2. **Tell us where to send it.** Add any email address—your own, a shared inbox, even a Slack channel email.
3. **Connect once, relax forever.** Provide an OpenRouter API key and grant Gmail send access; the agent handles scheduling, search and delivery from then on.

### Why teams love it

* **Instant competitive intelligence** – spot emerging rivals and partnership opportunities the day they launch.
* **Hours back every week** – no more manual Googling, RSS trawling or tab overload.
* **Action-ready subject lines** – e.g. “Weekly *{Topic}* Launch Trend Report – *{Date}*” so you can scan and share in seconds.
* **Error reporting built-in** – the agent flags any delivery issues, so you’re never left guessing.

### Inputs

* **Recipient Email** (required) – where the report lands.
* **Topic** (required) – the niche you care about.
* **Day Range** (optional) – how many days back to look (default 7).

### Output

* **Daily email briefing** + real-time status updates.

Perfect for product managers, founders, marketers, investors and analysts who need up-to-the-minute launch data without adding another task to the to-do list. Install now and **turn product-launch monitoring into an automatic habit.**

This agent converts YouTube video content into a LinkedIn post by analyzing the video's transcript. It provides you with a tailored post that reflects the core ideas, key takeaways, and tone of the original video, optimizing it for engagement on LinkedIn.

- Source YouTube Video – Provide the URL to the YouTube video
- Structure – Choose the post format (e.g., Personal Achievement Story, Thought Leadership, etc.)
- Content – Specify the main message or idea of the post (e.g., Hot Take, Key Takeaways, etc.)
- Tone – Select the tone for the post (e.g., Conversational, Inspirational, etc.)

OUTPUT:
- LinkedIn Post – A well-crafted, AI-generated LinkedIn post with a professional tone, based on the video content and your specified preferences

Perfect for content creators, marketers, and professionals who want to repurpose YouTube videos for LinkedIn and boost their professional branding.

name: Staff Engineer Plan Reviewer
description:
The most expensive bugs aren't in code — they're in the plan. A missing requirement, an unverified assumption, or quiet scope expansion can cost days of rework.

This agent reviews your implementation plan against the original ticket before coding starts. It checks whether the plan addresses what the ticket asks for, whether it contradicts itself, and whether codebase assumptions have been verified.

Especially valuable when using AI coding agents to implement tickets. A good plan should let the agent produce a correct implementation on the first try. If the agent's PR needs revisions, the problem is usually the plan. Fix it, scrap the attempt, start fresh. This reviewer helps get the plan right first.

How it works: submit your plan and ticket, get back a review of gaps, contradictions, and unverified assumptions. If it finds things to verify, it tells you what to check and how to record the result. Resubmit and it won't repeat itself. When the plan is solid, it says so.
